claim_boundary: This controlled pilot supports partial operator-relevant representation formation under generated sentence pressure. It does not establish spontaneous OSL emergence, open-ended symbol formation, or the same effect in large language models.

frozen_endpoints.important_qualification: Several endpoint metrics were subsequently shown to have strong random-feature or lexical explanations.

principal_conclusion: Generated sentences were sufficient for nontrivial provenance-sensitive behavior and weak latent alignment, but not for a clean emergent operator-symbolic language. Explicit state supervision and equivalence regularization substantially strengthened formal-state alignment and path invariance. Random-feature, lexical, and causal-intervention controls reject the stronger claim that answer-only training produced a coherent, causally manipulable symbolic operator algebra.
title: OSL Emergent Operator Geometry Pilot
